name: com.surendranb/macos-mcp
description: macOS MCP server with 40 tools for calendar, mail, reminders, notes, music, podcasts, camera, microphone, and system metrics — designed for agents that need local OS access.

tools.name: list_calendars
tools.description: Lists all available calendar names in the Apple Calendar app

tools.name: get_calendar_events
tools.description: Fetches calendar events for a given time range (using accli)

tools.name: create_calendar_event
tools.description: Creates a new event in Apple Calendar (using accli)

tools.name: get_reminders
tools.description: Fetches active reminders from Apple Reminders

tools.name: create_reminder
tools.description: Creates a new reminder in Apple Reminders

tools.name: complete_reminder
tools.description: Marks a reminder as completed

tools.name: list_notes
tools.description: Lists titles, IDs, and folders of notes in Apple Notes

tools.name: get_note
tools.description: Retrieves the body text of a note by title or ID

tools.name: create_note
tools.description: Creates a new note in Apple Notes

tools.name: update_note
tools.description: Appends content to an existing note in Apple Notes

tools.name: get_music_state
tools.description: Returns the current playback state and active track metadata in Apple Music

tools.name: play_playlist
tools.description: Plays a specific Apple Music playlist by name

tools.name: play_pause_music
tools.description: Toggles playback state of Apple Music

tools.name: skip_music_track
tools.description: Skips to the next or previous track in Apple Music

tools.name: set_music_volume
tools.description: Sets Apple Music volume (0 to 100)

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Composes and sends an email via Apple Mail

tools.name: get_unread_emails
tools.description: Fetches recent unread email details from Apple Mail

tools.name: send_imessage
tools.description: Sends an iMessage/SMS via Messages app

tools.name: open_url
tools.description: Opens a URL in the default browser

tools.name: get_safari_tabs
tools.description: Lists all open tab URLs and titles in Safari

tools.name: list_shortcuts
tools.description: Lists all Siri/Apple Shortcuts configured on the system

tools.name: run_shortcut
tools.description: Runs an Apple/Siri Shortcut by name

tools.name: get_disk_usage
tools.description: Returns local disk usage statistics

tools.name: get_storage_scan
tools.description: Deep storage scan: home directory sizes, caches, and local snapshots

tools.name: get_battery_health
tools.description: Detailed battery status: cycle count, max capacity, condition

tools.name: get_startup_items
tools.description: Lists macOS login items and LaunchAgents

tools.name: run_health_audit
tools.description: Comprehensive health audit: compute, memory, storage, battery, SSD wear, startup items

tools.name: run_disk_cleanup
tools.description: Safely prunes cache folders and empties trash to free up space

tools.name: get_system_stats
tools.description: Gets current CPU load, memory pressure, battery metrics, thermal level, and hung processes

tools.name: get_process_list
tools.description: Lists active running processes with resource usage

tools.name: kill_process
tools.description: Kills a process by PID or name

tools.name: restart_service
tools.description: Restarts a macOS launchd service using launchctl

tools.name: get_recent_podcast_episodes
tools.description: Lists podcast episodes from MTLibrary.sqlite, optionally filtered by release date range and/or title query. Returns pubDate, podcastTitle, title, playhead, duration, playState, transcriptId (path fragment), episodeId (Apple store track id). Pass a title to open_podcast_episode, and transcriptId to get_podcast_transcript once cached.

tools.name: get_podcast_transcript
tools.description: Retrieves the full transcript for an episode from the local Apple Podcasts TTML cache. Returns speaker-attributed text with timestamps. Requires the episode to have been opened/played at least once so the transcript file was cached locally.

tools.name: open_podcast_episode
tools.description: Searches Apple Podcasts for an episode title (from get_recent_podcast_episodes) and opens its episode page. Verified UI flow: Cmd+F, clipboard-paste the title (keystroke typing corrupts punctuation), open the top search result. Use before play_podcast_episode. The title should be fairly exact — the top search result is what gets opened.

tools.name: play_podcast_episode
tools.description: Plays the currently open episode page in Apple Podcasts (AX-discovers the play pill — position varies per page, so it is never hardcoded — and clicks it), then polls the TTML cache for up to ~15s for the transcript download. Returns the cached transcript path and transcriptId for get_podcast_transcript. Requires open_podcast_episode to have been called first.

tools.name: pause_podcast_episode
tools.description: Pauses Apple Podcasts playback via the Controls menu bar item. Note: the MTLibrary play_state column is unreliable (stays 1 while paused) — use the playhead field of get_recent_podcast_episodes to verify pause.

tools.name: capture_camera_snapshot
tools.description: Takes a photo using the built-in camera via imagesnap. Returns JPEG as base64 data URL. Use: ambient light sensing, health PPG read, presence detection.

tools.name: get_ambient_noise
tools.description: Records a short audio sample via microphone and measures ambient noise level in decibels. Returns average dB, peak dB, and classification (quiet/moderate/loud).

tools.name: capture_audio
tools.description: Records an audio clip via microphone and saves to a temp WAV file. Returns file path, duration, and sample rate.
